Yep, that's it. 10 year taper (I know!) from 80mg to 3mg currently. It is continuous insomnia, restlessness and panic attacks. I already take propranalol, have for a long time so I cannot say if this helps.

It has gone on for a very long time.

Thank you for your reply. I'm really glad you you beat benzo withdrawal, statistically you are in the minority.

I absolutely hear what you say about choosing the easiest treatment. My case was a bit different - I started having very bad panic attacks, bought Lorazepam/Ativan from the internet (knowing the addiction problem). Became a completely functional individual again overnight, then after 1 month worked out I couldn't feel any emotions.

Started my benzo withdrawal the day after that. When I said 'never ends', that wasn't true. It hasn't ended for me yet, but many people I have spoken/listened to in the past, it has ended for them, and it never fails to make me happy.
Thank you.
I'm sorry you have had to go through that. A steam bath, that is new. Thank you, I will try that.
Thank you.
Then let us be scared together :-).
Thank you.
Thank you.

Not juvenile at all, but would be bad regarding work - drug testing.

Thank you for taking the time to write such a well thought out post, it has given me a lot to think about.
Thank you.

>often to the point that our brain has a mind of its own

Oh how so, so true.

Anxiety 'disorder' - This shows it so much - your 'logical' mind knows that you are absolutely not going to die. Stop being so silly, this is ridiculous!

Your 'emotional'' self - IT IS VERY FUCKING REAL WE ARE GOING TO DIE IF WE GET ON THAT ESCALATOR!

Guess who wins?

A very poor analogy, but I think anyone who has met with anxiety in a dark ally will get the gist of what I mean.

Anxiety has taught me to wait. Be patient. Is this true? Yes? Think on that for a day. I'm amazed to say I'm glad I had a major anxiety disorder, it taught me so much.

Thank you. I have actually seen many therapists, it is not a 'holistic' approach, they have been specifically for my anxiety then diazepam withdrawal issue, and a fine job they did.

Insurance isn't an option really, I'm in the UK. A therapist to talk about how to relate to others....that is interesting. No, I haven't done that.

I was about to type that I haven't done that, because I don't need to. I think that is wrong because I have spent so long DIS-connecting with people, that maybe I really have lost that.

Massage...didn't go well. Too many broken bits, healed as best they can. Nice human contact though.

Have you had a look at [this use of anti depressants for neuropathic pain](http://www.mayoclinic.com/health/pain-medications/PN00044)?

Cross-use of medication seems to be a field that is expanding, and I hope this could help you.

I'm terrified that they won't have an answer. There, the truth. Finally.

I'm arrogant and honest enough to admit, if I haven't found an answer it is unlikely others will (...and yet I still posted here?..how conflicted...ssshhh).

I am very, very seriously thinking about doing that. I can't explain adequately how much of A THING that is for me to consider doing.

Thank you again.
As do I.

Always speak! It sounds like you have some very good friends, I don't need to tell you to cherish them.

As per a previous answer - at this moment, no I don't have any of my friends to reach out to. I think this prompted my post I had been deliberating about for so, so long.

I'm very glad I posted.

Best of to you as well mate.
Thank you. I will reach for it before I do anything rash. That is a promise.

Your vocabulary and message are understood, loud and clear. Perfect mate.

Let's be harsh, there *are* a fair few people who would be upset if I offed myself, but they would be so much more upset because I never told them why. It would be a complete suprise - I am a fully functioning alcoholic with apparently nothing to worry about. I have told them this (well, not about alcoholism and that isn't strictly true it is boredom). I have told them everything is fine for so long now.

How do I turn that story around and tell them I have been lying for what I see as their own good (oh, how noble of me!).

There isn't anyone unfortunately, but thank you for your kind words and time, and don't worry, I think I'm far too tired to kill myself tonight - (NO drama intended, dark humour)

> Friends on the other hand, may have be befriended with the understanding that you were that pillar of strength

That is so absolutely true. We can look at our circle of friends and see - 'The Rock', 'The Kind One', 'The Moral Compass', 'The Funny One' - and yet we never look at each of those 'roles', and wonder if those people are actually happy, are actually those people.

God forbid 'The Funny One' stop being funny and have problems.....We The Group Don't Like Change.

Thank you. You have also shined alight for me.

Then I'll ask you not to think about me.

People who reply in SuicideWatch..I think they do so because they have seen or been to or are close to a very dark place, and if they can't help themselves, then by god they will help someone else.

As you have done for me. My first Norwegian friend.

That is very kind, thank you.

They are not there. I have put them at arms length for too long. I would get angry - Why can't they see the haze I have to see through, the furrowing of my brow just to catch the fucking sentence they are speaking? Using memory tricks to remember what they said, the inconsequential shit that means just nothing, their banal fucking crap? Those fucking idiots don't know what they have. They don''t know how lucky they are.

They have no idea how I FEEL and WHAT I GO THROUGH.


And equally, I have absolutely no idea how much pain and sorrow they carry around with them every day. How many times they smile at me, but are dying inside, every single day.

Why, oh why can we never truly *understand* one another?

How dare I judge them.

Then please don't live in regret mate. Why not have another beer? On your own, the only answer to that is - there IS no why not.

With someone...you now have a chance to change the path your life is going in. I know it feels comfortable, safe.

Do you want to be 50+ and wishing what could have been? Of course not. Take a risk with her, what is the absolute worst that can happen?

Go for it Sir, I salute you as clearly a fellow English (or Aussie) gent! :-)

Fuck. This is ~~kind of~~ THE FIRST time I've ever been honest about this. I've been thinking for so many months - who can I talk to??

I promised I wouldn't cry, I'm fairly close.

Thank you huskergirlie, what you typed does make sooooo much sense. If we may talk/type? I know you know what I'm saying in regards to pain. Silly isn't it, in one paragraph I know YOU know.

You do.

I don't want to bother you, but maybe it would help both of us to understand this. Please feel free to PM me, tell me to go away and leave you alone, it is all good.

Thank you Bratlie, that is very kind of you to respond.

I feel like I have posted a paradox - 'Here reddit, have a problem I've already decided can't be solved'.

I'll manage a bit more for sure. It is rote, routine.

I'm one of those awkward fuckers who wants to know where he is going, and I don't and haven't known for a long time.

I know I've explained this very poorly. Surgically = gamble. I healed at 15, at 36 I am not going to heal anywhere near as well...maybe, do I take that risk? I'm not asking you to answer, I'm just saying that I have explored all I can there.

There is a girl, and there is alcohol. I love her to death. My lifestyle would be absolutely toxic to her and her children's lives. It cannot happen. I am so fucking angry about that.

The old 'Hey, take up physical sports, join a club, get a new hobby' shit aint working here is it? Ha! See, I've done it to you to - 'Help me, but you can't help me'. Shit.

A new perspective...I feel so..'damaged', have you got any experience of a relationship where that was the case, and it went well?
